resolvedQuestions.text: Which MCP 2.0 actions are read-only, draft-safe, destructive, publish-capable, or deployment-capable?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Operation classes enumerated per module/action in research.md Section 4; publishing always explicit; CMS mutations can hit live site

resolvedQuestions.text: Does the official surface use remote OAuth, a local server, an API token, or a client-specific connection flow?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Remote OAuth (mcp.webflow.com/sse, mcp-remote experimental) OR local bearer token (site/workspace/OAuth) via WEBFLOW_TOKEN; no client-specific flow

resolvedQuestions.text: Is mcp-webflow a workflow or a transport?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Transport: hub transport-leaf layout; mutations land in Webflow cloud; run_workflow executes Webflow-side managed workflows

resolvedQuestions.text: What non-production Webflow workspace or site can support live smoke?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Dedicated test workspace + test site; read-only scopes baseline; publish only to publishToWebflowSubdomain (staging), single page, 1/min

resolvedQuestions.text: Which Webflow operations require explicit operator confirmation, and which require a named rollback?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Publish/destructive/deploy classes confirmation-gated; staged-first rollback; API-level site restore UNKNOWN

resolvedQuestions.text: Which operations must pair with sk-design design judgment?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Designer-family (deElement/deStyle/deVariable/deComponents/deAsset, update_page_settings) pair with sk-design; Data-family operations do not

keyFindings.finding: Official server is webflow/mcp-server (npm webflow-mcp-server 1.0.1, MIT); MCP SDK 1.25.2 + webflow-api 3.2.1
Two connection modes: remote OAuth at https://mcp.webflow.com/sse (no bridge app for most actions) and local npx webflow-mcp-server with WEBFLOW_TOKEN
Full action inventory with operation classes (read-only/draft-safe/destructive/publish/deploy) extracted from src/tools/*.ts
Remote auth is mcp-remote (experimental); role gate owner/admin only; rate limits 60/120 rpm plan-based; site publish 1/min
Scopes table; workspace tokens lack site scope; publishToWebflowSubdomain = staging target
mcp-webflow is a transport (hub leaf layout); confirmation classes; sk-design pairing boundary
